body:
I have previous experience with cannabis, JWH-018, THJ-018, BB-22, 2NE1, AM-2201 and various blends.
This one is quite tame for a cannabinoid, the dry mouth is heavily pronounced. It triggered my HPPD mildly or on an intermediate level, more than with cannabis but less than other cannabinoids. Mental effects are mild to intermediate in different dosages, very high doses act like the more stronger cannabinoids.
I vapourised it on aluminium foil, depending on batch but generally it will melt or bubble into a pale transparent yellow oil and further applied heat produces a red oil than after burns to black, vapourisation was applied until a dark red color and not past, if done accidentally the emitted smoke or vapour is rejected for inhalation.
Overall a very moderate cannabinoid, with more gentle mental effects.
On another note it was very beneficial on the digestive system after a few days of repeated exposure, and was researched as an analgesic or anti-inflammatory by a pharmaceutical company.
The AB-FUBINACA has effects perhaps more attuned to a person cannabinoid naive than others. Withdrawal seems commensurate to natural cannabis consumption. Duration was around an hour but is dose dependent and route of administration dependent.
I would avoid combusting with cannabinoids as it probably increases the likelyhood of toxicity, aka spiking tobacco with it. Overall considering previous cannbinoid experiences it is a nice change in pace and effects but the dry mouth is very intense.
